title: Regex Tester
seoTitle: Free Regex Tester — Live Match & Groups | ToolNova
description: Test regular expressions against sample text with live matches, groups, and flags. Everything stays in your browser for privacy.
intro: Enter a pattern and flags, paste test text, and see matches highlighted with capture groups explained.
blurb: Test regular expressions with live matching and capture group details.

controls.label: Test text
controls.value: Contact support@example.com or sales@toolnova.org for help.

howItWorks: Enter your regular expression pattern and optional flags (g, i, m, etc.).
Paste the text you want to test against.
Click Test Regex to see all matches and their capture groups.
examples: Pattern \b\w+@\w+\.\w+\b with flag gi finds email addresses.
Use capturing groups like (\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) to extract date parts.
The global flag g finds every match instead of only the first.

faq.a: JavaScript's native RegExp engine, so lookbehind and other modern features work where the browser supports them.

faq.q: Are my patterns or text sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. Matching runs entirely in the browser.

faq.q: How do I see capture groups?
faq.a: Each match line shows the full match followed by any numbered or named groups.
